method: Compare each pinned PR head against its own verified merge-base, then intersect changed paths. Metadata only; no merge/import/source bodies or runtime checks.
filter: apps/cli/packages/ or packages/; ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs,json; exclude docs/test/tests/evidence/__tests__ directories and .test./.spec. filenames. This bounded filter does not cover every tracked file, binary asset or lockfile.
qualification: Same-path different blobs establish required version selection, not demonstrated behavioral conflict. Absence of another bounded same-path overlap does not prove interface compatibility. Earlier 18–25% estimate remains pinned to its historical heads; this report does not recalculate progress.
